_note: SYNTHETIC Taglish servicing call for Q4. The agent is compliant (disclosure and verification done) but misses a life event: the customer just had a baby, which should prompt a beneficiary and rider review. Ends with a callback request.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello po, good afternoon! Si Joy po ito from Kalinga Life. Para po sa quality, naka-record po ang tawag na ito. Si Ma'am Reyes po ba ito?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ma'am, para po sa verification, last four digits po ng policy number?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Salamat po. Paalala lang po, due na po ang quarterly premium ninyo sa October 7.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ay opo. Actually kakapanganak ko lang last month kaya medyo hectic. Baby girl po!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Congrats po, Ma'am! So kailan po kayo makakapagbayad?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sige po, noted. Pasok pa po iyon sa grace period.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Tsaka pwede bang idagdag ko yung baby ko as beneficiary?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Opo Ma'am, pwede po. Revocable po ang beneficiary ninyo kaya pwede pong palitan anytime.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sige po, pakitawagan na lang ako after 6pm para diyan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Noted po, tatawag po kami after 6pm. Salamat po!
